testcase.system-out: Scenario: Launch a command through a left-docked compact group key tip ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left ✔ And Modify is displayed as a compact group button ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls ✔ And the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M" ✔ When the user presses "M" ✔ Then key tips appear on the visible 3D Model commands and compact groups ✔ And the Modify group displays the key tip "Y" ✔ When the user presses "Y" ✔ Then the adjacent Modify command panel opens ✔ And its commands display key tips including "HO" for Hole ✔ When the user presses "H" ✔ Then the displayed command key tips narrow to matching H-prefixed entries ✔ When the user presses "O" ✔ Then the Hole properties panel opens ✔ And the ribbon key tips and adjacent Modify panel disappear ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the Hole properties panel ✔ Then the properties panel closes without creating a hole ✔ And the ribbon remains docked on the left
